panels.title: Backup Health
panels.description: Gesamtstatus aller Backups. Prüft NAS-Mount, Collector, OneDrive-Abfragen, Vorhandensein, 3-Wege-Match der Pi-Backups und ein maximales Backup-Alter von 36 Stunden.

panels.title: Home Assistant
panels.description: Local + NAS + OneDrive; Dateiname und Größe müssen übereinstimmen.

targets.expr:
(
  time() -
  backup_last_timestamp_seconds{
    service="homeassistant",
    target="onedrive"
  }
)
and
(
  backup_present{service="homeassistant",target="local"} == 1
)
and
(
  backup_present{service="homeassistant",target="nas"} == 1
)
and
(
  backup_present{service="homeassistant",target="onedrive"} == 1
)
and
(
  backup_cloud_query_success{service="homeassistant"} == 1
)
and
(
  backup_all_targets_match{service="homeassistant"} == 1
)
